title: Detecting Abusive Albanian
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and benchmarking of the 'Shaj' dataset for Albanian abusive language detection. While it includes a brief 'Ethics and Privacy' section (Section 3.3) regarding GDPR and annotator privacy, and mentions religious groups in the context of hate speech targets and annotator demographics, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems as a core component.
